tools.name: get_workflow_guide
tools.description: Return the overview, execution, or payment workflow guide. Use this instead of separate guide tools when you need lifecycle context; it is free, read-only, and returns the selected next steps without executing or paying.

tools.name: list_catalog
tools.description: List services, products, external capabilities, or network metadata with optional filters. This is free and read-only; use discover_agents for a task-specific match and create_paid_job only after selecting a service.

tools.name: discover_agents
tools.description: Match a natural-language requirement or structured capabilities to first-party services and registered agents. Returns ranked matches without side effects or cost; use list_catalog for exact schemas and prices, and create_paid_job to execute selected paid work.

tools.name: get_provider_integrations
tools.description: Return provider roles and integration metadata for planning. This is free and read-only; use list_catalog for purchasable capabilities and discover_agents for matching.

tools.name: service_recommendation
tools.description: Translate a business or product objective into the most relevant PrivateDAO capabilities and a practical next step.

tools.name: privatepay_status
tools.description: Read the current PrivatePAY x402 readiness, MagicBlock private-rail configuration, facilitator state, PDAO entry requirement, and public-chain privacy boundary. Call this first; it is free and read-only, creates no challenge, and never moves funds.

tools.name: privatepay_challenge
tools.description: Create a fresh PrivatePAY x402 v2 challenge for a resource and quoted USDC amount. Call this before privatepay_verify; it returns exact payment requirements and the PDAO private-settlement rule, but never signs, broadcasts, or charges a wallet.

tools.name: privatepay_checkout
tools.description: Create a MagicBlock PrivatePAY checkout or request the payment-required challenge for an existing checkout. Use this to begin a private checkout instead of create_paid_job with direct USDC; it returns commercial terms only and never signs, broadcasts, or moves funds.

tools.name: privatepay_prepare
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned MagicBlock deposit, private transfer, or withdrawal for a local wallet to inspect and sign. Call this after privatepay_checkout and before wallet authorization; PrivateDAO never receives a private key and this tool never broadcasts.

tools.name: privatepay_verify
tools.description: Verify an x402 v2 PrivatePAY payload through the configured facilitator against the exact original requirements. Call this after privatepay_challenge or privatepay_checkout and before privatepay_settle; it is read-only, fail-closed, and returns redacted evidence without spending funds.

tools.name: privatepay_settle
tools.description: Settle an already verified x402 v2 PrivatePAY payload through the configured facilitator and return redacted settlement evidence. Call this only after privatepay_verify with unchanged requirements; this is the payment-moving action and may create facilitator-side or on-chain settlement.

tools.name: privatepay_job_payment
tools.description: Apply a finalized PrivatePAY x402 payment to an existing paid job and execute it once. Use this instead of submit_payment for a job created with payment_mode=privatepay; it consumes supplied payment proof, may settle funds, and returns workflow evidence.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an asset/record or retrieve and validate a PrivateDAO receipt. Returns structured evidence and hashes; it is free and read-only, never pays or executes work, and replaces the separate basic, receipt, and get-receipt paths.

tools.name: create_paid_job
tools.description: Create a selected paid PrivateDAO capability request and return an immediate result or exact quote-first payment intent. Use discover_agents or list_catalog first; payment_mode=privatepay starts the PrivatePAY flow, while direct uses ordinary USDC. This call never spends funds.

tools.name: submit_payment
tools.description: Confirm an authorized payment reference for a selected request and return the payment/execution result. Use this after create_paid_job and only with the exact returned quote; it may write payment state and never accepts a guessed amount.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Read the current state, exact payment intent, result, or receipt reference for a request. Poll this after create_paid_job, privatepay_job_payment, or submit_payment; it is free and read-only, never retries payment, and never executes work again.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel an unpaid pending request before execution and return its updated status. It records cancellation only, never spends or refunds funds, and must not be used after payment or execution has started.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "privatepay_prepare" references sensitive artifacts (private key, authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
